cluster_reason: BackgroundInitializer and MultiBackgroundInitializer form a focused initializer subdomain: MultiBackgroundInitializer composes and manages multiple BackgroundInitializer instances. They have direct internal dependencies and are cohesive, with limited coupling to the rest of the package (mostly using ConcurrentException/ConcurrentUtils). Moving them together isolates initializer-related responsibilities without affecting central utilities or exception classes.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive initializer cluster (BackgroundInitializer + MultiBackgroundInitializer) into a new initializer subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage for initializer-related classes if it does not exist.
Move BackgroundInitializer to the initializer subpackage to group initializer behavior.
Move MultiBackgroundInitializer alongside BackgroundInitializer so internal package-private interactions remain local to the new subpackage.
